LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Enlist_Letter_Title: You have joined the Followers of the Apocalypse.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Enlist_Letter_Label: Welcome to the chapter. There's always more wounded than hands to treat them, so pull your weight and you'll always have a bed, a meal, and a wage waiting for you at any chapter you find.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Enlist_Button_Label: Join the Followers of the Apocalypse.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Sat: You need to have minimum of 10 goodwill, currently you have only {0} goodwill.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Enlisted_With_Key: Enlisted with: The Followers of the Apocalypse
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Menu_Missions_Desc: An administrator asks whether you'd be willing to help with a chapter's aid work.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Salary_Desc: You are entitled to collect your stipend from this faction every 14 days. It isn't much - the chapter spends what it has on medicine, not wages.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Provisions_Desc:
Provisions will arrive via your caravan inventory every 10 days:

- Industrial medicine
- Survival meals
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Storage_Desc: Store items from your caravan to your faction stash. Faction stashes transfer across all of the faction's chapters and will save contents even if you are no longer enlisted.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Clinic_Duty_Desc: Work the chapter clinic. This service tends to all of your team with industrial medicine. Immunity gain is also increased while your team is under care.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Archive_Duty_Desc:
Study and teach in the chapter archive with hourly experience gain on the following skills:

- Intellectual, Social

Hourly experience gain stops when this faction is resting at night.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Aid_Rounds_Desc: Walk the wards and make rounds for $6 an hour.
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Resign_Menu_Text: You will resign from the Followers of the Apocalypse effective immediately. (-25 in relations)
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Resign_Button_Label: You have successfully resigned from the Followers of the Apocalypse. (-25 relations)
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Factio: cannot join because you are enlisted with their enemy, {HOSTILEFACTION_name}
LanguageData.FCP_Followers_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The chapter has let you go. You have been released from the {FACTION_name}.
